raw_segments.text: Macbeth, time thou anticipates my dread exploits, the flighty purpose never is or took unless
From this moment the very firstlings of my heart shall be the firstlings of my hand,
and even now to crown my thoughts with acts be it thought and done, the castle of Macduff
I will surprise, seize upon fife, give to T.H., edge O.T.H., sword his wife, his babes,
and all unfortunate souls that trace him in his line.
No boasting like a fool, this deed I'll do before this purpose cool, but no more sights.
Where are these gentlemen? Come, bring me where they are.
